name: Crowdsignal
description_en:
Crowdsignal, built by Automattic, creates surveys, polls, quizzes and ratings that can be shared or embedded. The builder focuses on collecting audience answers, customizing presentation and exporting results, including a WordPress-oriented publishing route. It is not a respondent panel or traffic-measurement service.

Its important capacity unit is the signal: a poll answer or a single survey/quiz question answer. A five-question completed survey uses five signals, so the free allowance is not equivalent to 2,500 completed questionnaires.
description_zh:
Crowdsignal 由 Automattic 开发，用于创建可分享或嵌入的问卷、投票、测验和评分，重点是收集回答、定制呈现及导出结果，也有面向 WordPress 的发布路径。它不是受访者样本库或流量衡量服务。

其关键容量单位是 signal，即一次投票或问卷／测验中一道题的回答。完成五题问卷会产生五个 signal，因此免费额度并不等于 2,500 份完整问卷。

core_features.explanation_en: Build and share audience questions with themes and embeds.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过主题和嵌入建立并分享问题。

core_features.name_zh: 按 signal 限制免费容量
core_features.explanation_en: Each answered survey or quiz question consumes one signal.
core_features.explanation_zh: 每道已回答的问卷或测验题消耗一个 signal。

core_features.explanation_en: Premium adds branching, report filters and Google Sheets sync; Business adds stronger branding/API options.
core_features.explanation_zh: Premium 增加分支、报表筛选及 Google Sheets 同步，Business 增加品牌与 API 选项。

en: Publish a poll, then analyze a larger questionnaire
zh: 先发布投票，再分析较长问卷
use_cases.basis: Editorial task and fit judgments grounded in the attached primary sources; no observed deployment.

Research scope.en: Public documentation and commercial access reviewed; examples are proposed evaluation workflows.
Research scope.zh: 核对公开文档与商业入口；示例是建议的评估流程。

target_audience.organization_sizes_en: Select by workflow, volume and governance needs; no universal size claim.
target_audience.organization_sizes_zh: 按流程、用量与治理需求选择，不宣称适合所有规模。

steps.en: Use an account, prepare a questionnaire, select a theme and test the share link or embed in its actual destination. WordPress integration is an available route, not a requirement that every respondent own a WordPress account. Check export access on Free before assuming the data can be moved in full. The reviewed service is hosted; the existence of a WordPress plugin does not establish the hosted service as open source or self-hostable.
steps.zh: 创建账户、准备问题、选择主题，并在真实发布位置测试链接或嵌入。WordPress 集成是一种路径，不要求所有受访者拥有 WordPress 账户。应先检查 Free 导出权限，不能假定全部数据都可迁出。所读服务为托管产品；WordPress 插件的存在不能证明托管服务开源或可自行托管。

items.en: This is a candidate for publishers and teams needing polls or modest questionnaires where embed convenience matters. Branching, duplicate restrictions and exports have plan conditions. A vote restriction is not proof of one real human per response, and a site visitor poll is self-selected. Test display on the intended site, language pack and report filters. Email delivery, recovery guarantees, partial-answer accounting and exact API limits were not verified.
items.zh: 需要投票或适量问卷、看重嵌入便利的出版者及团队可列入候选。分支、防重复和导出受套餐条件约束。限制投票不能证明每份回答对应一个真实人，网站访客投票也存在自选择。应在目标网站测试显示、语言包和报表筛选。邮件投递、恢复保证、部分回答计数及具体 API 限制未核实。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Free is $0 without a card, allows unlimited questionnaires and questions, and exposes up to 2,500 signals with limited exports and Crowdsignal branding. Above the cap, the service says collection continues but additional signals are not visible until upgrading. Premium is $25 monthly or $15/month billed annually; Business $59 monthly or $45 annually equivalent. Team is $29 per user/month billed annually and describes a three-user team. A 30-day money-back guarantee is not a free trial.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: Free 为 0 美元且免信用卡，问卷和题数无限，可查看最多 2,500 signal，导出受限并保留品牌。超过上限后，服务说明继续收集，但升级前无法查看新增 signal。Premium 月付 25 美元或按年每月等值 15 美元；Business 月付 59 美元或按年等值 45 美元。Team 每用户每月 29 美元、按年计费，页面描述三人团队。30 天退款保证不等于免费试用。

sections.title_en: Publish a poll, then analyze a larger questionnaire
sections.title_zh: 先发布投票，再分析较长问卷
sections.en: For an editorial team, embed a single-choice reader poll in a page, or distribute a short multi-question feedback survey. Decide whether repeat votes should be restricted and whether you need a branch for different reader groups. Examine the results and export path before launching a larger study. Signal budgeting matters: 400 respondents answering five questions use 2,000 signals. This arithmetic describes the documented unit, not a measured response campaign or representative sample.
sections.zh: 编辑团队可在页面嵌入单选读者投票，或分发简短多题反馈问卷。先决定是否限制重复投票，以及是否按读者群设置分支。扩大研究前检查结果与导出路径。signal 预算很重要：400 人各答五题会消耗 2,000 signal。这是按文档单位计算，不是实测活动，也不代表具有代表性的样本。
